info.name: Rackspace Cloud Identity Users API
info.description:
The Rackspace Cloud Identity API (v2.0) issues authentication tokens and manages users, tenants, roles, domains, identity providers, multi-factor authentication, secret questions, and phone PINs. It is the access-control plane for all Rackspace Cloud APIs and supports password, API-key, token, SAML federation, and multi-factor credential flows.

Contact Support:
 Name: Rackspace Technology
